title: ReserveStock
description: Command (ADR 0006). Sent by order-service through its outbox (topic = this name, key = orderId). Consumed by inventory-service. Holds stock for every line of one order, all or nothing (BR-INV-11); group inventory-reserve-stock. Answered by StockReserved or StockReservationRejected. A duplicate with the same lines changes nothing and re-publishes the reply; the same orderId with different lines is a contract error (DLT). Rejected as STALE_COMMAND when occurredAt is older than the hold TTL.

merchantId.description: Owner of the order's store. inventory scopes every read and write by merchantId + storeId.

orderId.description: Saga id and Kafka key; one order belongs to one store (BR-ORD-01).

orderItemId.description: Unique within the order; one reservation per order line.
